title: TRUEYES: UTILIZING MICROTASKS IN MOBILE APPS FOR CROWDSOURCED LABELING OF MACHINE LEARNING DATASETS
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not benchmark or measure anything related to faith or religion. It evaluates a crowdsourcing system by measuring the success rate and time-per-label for an image labeling task.
findings: This paper has no findings related to religion, as its focus is on a crowdsourcing system for machine learning data labeling.
references: M. I. Jordan and T. M. Mitchell. Machine learning: Trends, perspectives, and prospects. Science, 349(6245):255-260, 2015.
